name: oos-investigations
description: Investigate an out-of-specification (OOS) lab result from the original result, approved specification, analyst notes, raw data and retest history. Build the Phase I evidence chronology and hypothesis register, check retests, resampling, averaging and outlier tests against FDA, MHRA and EU GMP expectations, and draft the Phase II handoff with missing-record requests, other-batch impact and reporting clocks. For QC investigators and QA reviewers working from pasted records and exports.
